matrix.name: Global Symbol.for capability is eliminated and forged payload yields untrusted token
matrix.assertion: TRUSTED_ORCHESTRATOR_CAPABILITY is undefined; unbacked payload generates swai_ci_untrusted_* token

matrix.name: Public register helper is unexported; test-only helper strictly forces mock quarantine
matrix.assertion: registerVerifiedRemoteCiRun is undefined; _testOnlyRegisterVerifiedRemoteCiRun forces isUnitTestMock: true

matrix.name: Signed forged HMAC without authentic server fetch fails across verifier, validator, and evaluator
matrix.assertion: HMAC token signed by external secret without registry presence fails all verification gates

matrix.name: Private source admit requires genuine provider result; customFetch mock is quarantined
matrix.assertion: verifyRemoteGitHubActionsRun with customFetch tags proof as isUnitTestMock: true

matrix.name: NODE_ENV tampering and spoofing isUnitTestMock:false cannot bypass mock quarantine
matrix.assertion: Setting NODE_ENV=production or isUnitTestMock:false in test helper fails to bypass quarantine

matrix.name: Parser test fixtures registered via test helper are explicitly UNIT_TEST_MOCK
matrix.assertion: Fixtures registered via test helper fail release evaluation with RELEASE_EVALUATOR_REJECTED_MOCK_CI

matrix.name: Wrong workflow path, branch, SHA, repo, event, conclusion, or status fails closed
matrix.assertion: Mismatches in repository, branch, workflowPath, headSha, status, or conclusion reject token minting

matrix.name: Proof registered for C0 fails when validated against C1; expired TTL fails
matrix.assertion: Valid token for C0 fails validation against C1; tokens older than max TTL are rejected

matrix.name: Identical run registration is idempotent; conflicting metadata throws or rejects
matrix.assertion: Re-registering same runId with identical data succeeds; conflicting data throws error

matrix.name: Release is blocked when all other gates pass but CI proof is unverified
matrix.assertion: evaluateReleaseEvidence returns RELEASE_NO_GO when ciStatus is not CI_PASS

matrix.name: Exported module surface contains zero private registration or token-minting primitives
matrix.assertion: githubActionsCiEvidence exports only safe query, validation, and test mock helpers

matrix.name: Provider check without credentials truthfully returns CI_NOT_CONFIGURED / CI_NOT_RUN
matrix.assertion: verifyRemoteGitHubActionsRun without token or runId returns unverified CI_NOT_CONFIGURED

matrix.name: Gate validation rejects exit code 0 when Vitest summary is absent
matrix.assertion: Command returning exit 0 without parseable test summary is rejected as FAILED

matrix.name: Gate validation rejects exit 0 if tests failed or total tests is zero
matrix.assertion: Tests failed > 0 or total tests === 0 causes gate validation to fail

matrix.name: Resource safety checker fails closed on statfs error, insufficient disk, or insufficient RAM
matrix.assertion: Disk < 1 GiB or RAM < 150 MB causes checkResourceSafety to throw SAFE_CHECK_FAILED

matrix.name: Worktree integrity check detects HEAD or Tree mutation
matrix.assertion: Modifying files or HEAD commit during gate execution is detected and fails closed

matrix.name: DAG structure maintains concurrency limits and serializes database-dependent gates
matrix.assertion: Max concurrency 2 is enforced; E5, E8, E9 have strict dependency ordering

matrix.name: TailRingBuffer retains recent log tail; gate validator flags TRUNCATED_FAIL on overflow
matrix.assertion: Ring buffer retains last 100 lines; logs exceeding 50 MB flag TRUNCATED_FAIL

matrix.name: HTTP 401, 403, 404, 429, 500 all fail closed with CI_NOT_RUN and verified: false
matrix.assertion: Non-200 HTTP responses from GitHub API fail closed without verified proof

matrix.name: Fixture records, pseudo-references, and <60-day series remain strictly INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
matrix.assertion: Pseudo-references like 'verified-merchant-demand' and series <60 days fail G15/G16
